Thanks for helping build a useful, accurate resource for the New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe modding community.

== Before editing ==

* Check whether the topic already has a page.
* Use the tool's upstream repository for current requirements and setup details.
* Keep general modding information separate from claims about Steam's ''New Super Mario Bros. Deluxe'' project.
* Do not publish private messages, personal information, or material you do not have permission to share.

== Writing standards ==

* State facts plainly and link to a source for technical claims.
* Include relevant game, tool, and emulator versions.
* Mark uncertain findings as under investigation or speculative.
* Prefer short, task-focused sections and descriptive page titles.
* Use headings in order and write useful alt text for images.
* Explain when a page was last checked if its instructions can become outdated.

== Images and files ==

Upload only original work or files you have permission to publish. Do not upload the base game, extracted game assets, executables, or other Nintendo-owned files. Attribute creators according to their stated preferences.

== Talk pages and corrections ==

Use a page's talk page to discuss substantial changes or unclear claims. When correcting outdated information, link the new source and note the affected versions.

See [[Community Guidelines]] for the wiki's scope and sharing rules.
